body: You can compress your blocks! 18 levels of compression! A French description is available ! You can compress your blocks! You can go up to 18 levels of compression! You can use this system on several Minecraft blocks, like cobblestone (available), dirt (coming soon), sand (coming soon), and many more ! You can now easily make room in your vaults through compression, while retaining the essence of the original block and conserving resources for future use. Too much cobblestone? No problem. We compress 9 stacks of cobblestone into 1 stack of level 1 compressed cobblestone, which we can then compress in turn.
